alerts.title: Phishing campaign impersonating local banking SMS alerts
alerts.description: Multiple reports of SMS messages impersonating regional banks, directing users to fake login pages that harvest banking credentials. Messages typically claim account suspension or unusual activity requiring immediate verification.

alerts.title: Rise in public WiFi Evil Twin attacks at transit hubs
alerts.description: Security researchers observed an increase in rogue access points mimicking airport and cafe WiFi networks in major regional transit hubs, designed to intercept unencrypted traffic and credentials.

alerts.title: Fake security app clones distributing spyware via third-party app stores
alerts.description: Threat intelligence sources report cloned versions of popular mobile security apps being distributed through unofficial app stores, bundled with spyware capable of harvesting contacts, SMS, and location data.

alerts.title: Increase in social engineering calls impersonating telecom support
alerts.description: Reports of callers impersonating telecom customer support requesting OTP codes under the pretext of resolving account issues. Legitimate telecom providers never request OTP codes over the phone.
